title: Florence-2
paper_title: Florence-2: Advancing a Unified Representation for a Variety of Vision Tasks
core_mech: 核心不是增加多个 head，而是用任务提示和位置 token 将 caption、检测、grounding、分割全部改写为 seq2seq。
core_mech_en: Reformulates captioning, object detection, phrase grounding, and segmentation into a single prompt-driven sequence-to-sequence generation task with quantized coordinate tokens.
input_desc: 图像与任务提示，例如 caption、detect、ground 或 segment
output_desc: 文本、类别与量化位置 token 序列，后处理为描述、框或多边形
output_en: Unified token sequence decoding text descriptions, class labels, and quantized 0–999 bounding-box or polygon coordinates

source.title: Florence-2
notes: Atlas GitHub URL microsoft/Florence-2 returned 404. Microsoft's public Hugging Face Florence-2-base release is the verified original source.
Only public model-card metadata was inspected. No gated files or pretrained weights were downloaded; code, weights and dataset terms must each be respected.

gaps: Florence-2 uses a task-conditioned vision/language architecture and task-specific token/output processing. Its released checkpoint and full workflow are not integrated here.
